This photo shows leftovers after a meal, so I estimated only the food still visible:

- Noodles, partly eaten: about 100 g, roughly 160 kcal.
- Lasagna, one small piece plus sauce residue: about 90 g, roughly 150 kcal.
- Green salad, which looks mostly untouched: about 70 g, roughly 30 kcal.
- Chocolate bar in its wrapper: it may be unopened, so I assumed about 40 g, roughly 200 kcal.
- Fruit or sauce residue in the bowl: about 15 g, roughly 10 kcal.
- The small plate with a wooden stirrer holds no food.

These add up to about 550 kcal and about 315 g.
